ACTION=A2
The pedestrian is located at x=23.0m and y=-4.0m, moving in the positive y-direction (towards the ego vehicle's lane) at 1.6 m/s. The ego vehicle is traveling at 30 kph (~8.33 m/s). The time for the ego vehicle to reach the pedestrian's x-position is approximately 2.76 seconds. In that time, the pedestrian will move from y=-4.0m to y=-4.0 + (1.6 * 2.76) ≈ 0.42m. Since the drivable area starts at y=-1.75m, the pedestrian will enter the drivable path well before the ego vehicle arrives. Therefore, the ego vehicle must decelerate to yield to the crossing pedestrian. A2 represents a moderate deceleration/yield action appropriate for this conflict.
